about: B1 CI floors: the current clusterer (fetcher.cluster.cluster_items, with the B7 embedding term fed the fixtures' committed vectors, embeddings_*.json) run on each gold fixture must score at least these. Floors only ratchet up: set a fixture's floors from `python -m fetcher.bundle_eval score <fixture>` (the embedding-term re-run line), rounded down to 4 decimals, and never lower one. Every gold_*.json needs an entry here. `lexical` holds B2's floors for the fallback path (no vectors), which must keep scoring them.
